body:
I should first tell you that I suffer from an anxiety disorder and I have been prescribed a variety of SSRIs and SSDRIs over the course of the last 10 years.  Those medications and meditation definitely help me with anxiety, but I still have problems so I've been in search of something to supplement my current treatment and it looked like Blue Lotus may fit the bill.
I put 10 grams of blue lotus in a stovetop percolator with two cups of water.  It didnt work out too well.  The two cups of water didnt create enough steam and after 20 minutes I was left with very weak Blue Lotus tea.  The water was barely discolored.
I moved onto plan B and poured the weak tea into a cup. I then took a normal metal tea filter, which only holds what you would use for normal cup of tea (two grams) and submerged two grams at a time into the hot water.  Although this wasnt ideal, I still managed to get two large cups of very strong tea.
The taste was manageable for first few sips, but it became a real struggle to get the rest down without vomiting.  I ended up chasing each sip with a ginger ale.  The first effects were felt about 15 minutes drinking all of the tea.  I felt distinctively more relaxed, but not tired.

I was watching meditation nature videos (which I have done many times before) and I noticed how the colors were especially beautiful.  There were brief moments when I felt as though I was somewhat part of the nature pictures in the video, but was very much in touch with the reality that I was sitting in my basement.
About 15 minutes later, I went upstairs with my wife. I was unusually talkative and felt more affectionate toward her.  I had the desire to stroke her hair and noticed (more so than usual) how beautiful she was.  We sat in bed and talked and laughed for about 20 minutes as I stroked her hair and body, which was also very unusual.  We then made love for about 40 minutes, which is about twice our norm.    I also lasted through two of her orgasms.  Normally, she is lucky to keep me hanging on through one.   I then went to sleep and woke the next morning with no ill effects.
Except for the horrendous taste, it was a really nice experience.  I dont smoke so Ill be searching for way to ingest this stuff that doesnt involve two cups of tea.
